mechanisms.origin: RM2 v1; accepted RM1 Root Cause A
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: The top-ranked conflicting state again terminates before a later bounded requested-state candidate is evaluated.
mechanisms.utility_impact: Removes premature state-conflict blocking; with M1 downstream semantics Q_DEV_TR_PEND_001 is recoverable, while Q_DEV_CASH_UNREC_001 still lacks direct NEXT_ACTION support.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: One bounded pool helper plus duplicated use in assessment and selection.

mechanisms.origin: FIX1 after RM2-v1 cross-domain state/scope rejection
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: Requested-state recovery can select same-state evidence from another product domain.
mechanisms.utility_impact: Constrains recovery rather than adding answers.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: Three explicit bounded domain families and three mapping constants; necessary because exact M1 intent_scope intersection cannot connect state variants such as failed_transfer and pending_transfer.

mechanisms.mechanism: removal of same-scope STANDARD capacity padding
mechanisms.origin: RM2 v1; accepted RM1 Root Cause B
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: A locally supported same-scope but off-objective chunk can be selected and claimed solely to fill max_evidence.
evidence: RM1 isolated same-scope CHECKS plus STATE counterfactual
mechanisms.utility_impact: May reduce supplemental claims but eliminates a proven off-objective leakage path.

mechanisms.origin: RM2 v1; accepted RM1 Root Cause B
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: The generic scorer may choose an off-objective sentence from an otherwise eligible mixed chunk.
evidence: RM1 source trace and objective-insensitive claim reproduction
mechanisms.utility_impact: Preserves answers only where an exact sentence supports the requested dimension.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: Adds exact sentence identity and an opt-in sentence-only dimension check.

mechanisms.origin: RM2 v1; accepted RM1 Root Cause B
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: Selection-time objective support is lost before generation and the generator can rescore a different sentence.
evidence: RM2 B3/B5 and exact-quote tamper controls
mechanisms.utility_impact: No target count is required; it makes the chosen answer sentence deterministic and objective-bound.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: Reuses the M1 FactualObjective dataclass; adds a tuple return and one pipeline argument.

mechanisms.origin: RM2 v1; accepted RM1 Root Cause B
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: Generation can emit a different locally supported sentence than the objective-bound sentence selected by routing.
mechanisms.utility_impact: Converts missing or non-exact binding to fail-closed abstention.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: Replaces the generic scorer with a short exact-objective loop.

mechanisms.origin: FIX2 after FIX1 end-to-end fallback binding defect
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: If the below-threshold fallback remains ID-only, another sentence or heading-assisted support from the same item can inherit authorization.
mechanisms.utility_impact: Preserves a bounded M1 fallback path while preventing sentence substitution; removing fallback entirely would be safer but more abstention-prone.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: One five-field dataclass and assessment-selection coupling.

mechanisms.origin: FIX3 after FIX2 request-target entity review defect
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: Synthetic same-domain wrong-entity T/O fixtures may pass dimension support, but the accepted RM1 CHECKS-versus-STATE defect remains closed by exact dimension/objective binding.
mechanisms.utility_impact: Introduced the only M1-to-FIX5 development utility loss: Q_DEV_CARD_REVERT_001 STANDARD to ABSTAIN because balance and ledger return are not equated.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: Large heuristic grammar, several token sets, diagnostics, and duplicated assessment/selection use.

mechanisms.origin: FIX4 after FIX3 order-sensitive target-anchor rejection
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: Target/entity hardening becomes word-order sensitive, but Root A/B closure does not depend on a generalized target grammar.
mechanisms.utility_impact: No W3-001 outcome change versus FIX3.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: Adds bidirectional adjacency, sentence-boundary, precedence, and extraction-basis logic.

mechanisms.origin: FIX5 after FIX4 multi-constraint underbinding rejection
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: The generalized target engine may retain only one coordinated entity requirement, while the minimum RM1 requested-dimension contract remains enforceable.
mechanisms.utility_impact: No W3-001 outcome change versus FIX4.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: Adds coordination parsing, residual token promotion, requirement details, and equivalence classes.

mechanisms.origin: FIX5 after FIX4 multi-constraint underbinding rejection
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: A generalized multi-requirement response may be partial; this is P1 completeness, not the proven RM1 same-scope/off-dimension leakage path.
evidence: No W3-001 utility gain and no accepted RM1 set-cover requirement
mechanisms.utility_impact: No W3-001 outcome change versus FIX4; enables synthetic multi-claim answers and additional fail-closed abstentions.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: Couples extraction diagnostics to combinatorial selection over sentence candidates.

mechanisms.origin: FIX5 to make one-evidence multi-claim set-cover compatible with the unchanged verifier
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: Two claims from one evidence item create duplicate citation evidence objects and fail verification.
mechanisms.utility_impact: Only needed when multiple STANDARD claims are selected from one item.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: Small alias map; no public field-shape change, but unnecessary for a one-objective RM2 design.

mechanisms.regression_if_removed: The approved failed-transfer sentence with plural repeated attempts ceases to match RETRY under exact sentence-only binding.
evidence: B8 positive and B9 unrelated-login negative
mechanisms.utility_impact: Preserves one established M1 development answer without broadening to unrelated attempts.

mechanisms.origin: FIX1 after unauthorized RM2-v1 stop-token expansion
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: Reintroducing stop promotes Q_DEV_CASH_UNREC_001 under an RM1 hypothesis that was never accepted as a root cause.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: No added complexity; restores M1 behavior.

mechanisms.origin: FIX4 correction of FIX3 TIMING versus TIMING_WINDOW key mismatch
mechanisms.regression_if_removed: The optional target/entity parser does not derive the timing target path; the original M1 timing authority check remains independent.
evidence: FIX4 U8 and timing helper audit
Q_DEV_CARD_REVERT_001 utility regression originates in this optional balance-target path
mechanisms.utility_impact: No FIX3-to-FIX4 development gain; preserves the FIX3 6/10 result.
mechanisms.complexity_impact: Small correction inside a larger optional grammar.

unresolved_target_audit.reason: RM1 does not require generalized target requirement discovery; extracted known anchors still fail closed through missing_target_requirements, while unknown unresolved requirements cannot currently be represented. This weakens the generalized P1 completeness claim, not the bounded Root A/B closure.
